column1: #  TIN sprint reports — sourced from "TIN_Sprint_NN_*_Report.xlsx" (Summary + All Tickets sheets, like Program;
#  sprint # is in the filename/title, not a sheet). Completion % = the Summary's "% Complete (excl. blocked)" =
#  completed / (total - pending-3rd - waiting), the in-our-control basis. completed/closed = Done/Resolved/Awaiting-Publish count.

column7: Sprint 11. In-our-control completion 92.7% (38 of 41; 0 blocked, so same as raw % Complete). 38 Done, 1 Acceptance Testing, 2 In Progress.

Sprint 12 (Oct 26-Nov 9). In-our-control 84.6% (22 of 26 after 5 blocked Pending-3rd-Party/Waiting); raw was 71.0% (22/31). 72 open-capacity / mid-sprint-added tickets excluded from the committed set per the report.
